'''2007 Match Play Championship Day 1 Steve Yaeger LS Local Uprising''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Steve Yaeger]] at [[2007 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Local Uprising / Liberation|SE-L-localuprising.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Steven Yaeger
* '''Deck name:''' TOD Main's &#91;scribbled&#93;, Down Under - Straight from the Land Down Under
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
